name: JSON Lens
description: A Rust JSON editor for desktop and browser. Explore JSON as a graph, or paste two documents for an automatic, aligned comparison.
features: Graph and source navigation with an initial graph overview
Automatic comparison with aligned rows and linked scrolling
Preserved object key order and arbitrary-precision numbers
Wrapped editor lines and active-line highlighting
Base64, URL, Hex and nested JSON previews on hover
JSON and CSV import; browser files stay local

controls.sort: Click to cycle: original → ascending → descending → original
controls.graph: Drag to pan; double-click a card to fold or unfold its branch
controls.theme: Follows the system theme; click the lamp to switch light or dark
controls.path: ~ is the root; hover a truncated bottom path to see it in full
controls.json_status: Each comparison input has its own status in the bottom bar

shortcuts.redo: Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + Z or Ctrl/Cmd + Y
